sites.source: https://dubuquecountyiowa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7621/Heritage-Pond-Campgrounds-Map-PDF (legend 'Reservable Campsite' 1-15, 'Non-reservable' 16-20, 'Tent Site' 21-24) + mycountyparks campsite pages 01, 08, 15 ('65 foot gravel back in site'), read 2026-11-03

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/dubuque/park/heritage-campground-pond ('There currently are no shower houses located on site. A pit latrine is located a short distance away closer to the Heritage Pond.'; amenity 'Dump station'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Water outlets to the sites are shut off approximately November through March.

season.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/dubuque/park/heritage-campground-pond ('The Heritage Campground & Pond is open year around ... Water outlets to individual campsites will be shut off approximately November through March each season.'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Sites 1-15 book on mycountyparks.com; 16-20 are first-come at the self-registration kiosk. 'Reservations must be made 4 days in advance of the date of reservation.' Non-refundable; one reschedule for $15, by phone at least 14 business days ahead.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Dubuque/Park/Heritage-Campground-Pond/Facility/Heritage-Campground-Campsite-01/Availability ('Reservations must be made 4 days in advance', 'Reservations may be made up to ONE YEAR in advance', 'No camping party ... shall occupy any camp area for more than 14 days', 'NON-REFUNDABLE') + county map (16-20 'Non-reservable', 'Self-Registration Kiosk'), read 2026-11-03

note: Dubuque County Conservation Board park 3 mi north of Dubuque off US 52 at the eastern Heritage Trail trailhead, with trail links into Dubuque. The 9-acre trout pond lies across Sageville Road and the trail extension from the sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, 50A + water, 65-ft back-ins, dump, pit latrine, no showers, reservable + FCFS. Sites 20 -> 24 (15 reservable, 5 FCFS, 4 tent); season filled year-round; booking window/4-day lead/14-night max added. Not waterfront confirmed (pond, road between). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): the county calls it 'a 9 acre pond' and on NAIP the site rows sit southwest of Sageville Road and the Heritage Trail Extension, which run between every pad and the shore (the trailhead lot and pit latrine are on the pond side). A pond across a road is not waterfront.
SITES: the county map shows 24 sites (1-15 reservable, 16-20 non-reservable, 21-24 tent); mycountyparks lists only 1-15. The stored 20 matched the electric sites only.
PIN fine: stored pin is on the trailhead lot ~70 m northeast of the site rows.
